sources: See header comments in generate_households.ts for full citations (NPHC 2024, UDHS 2022, this project's real admin-hierarchy data).

assumptions.settlement_type: Derived heuristically from subcounty-name pattern (Division/Town Council names skew peri-urban/trading centre; plain rural subcounty names skew rural), not a cited urban/rural classification table.
assumptions.head_age_shape: Sampled via a Gaussian centred at 40 (sd 11), clipped to [18,90], to approximate the requested 25-55 skew — no cited household-head age distribution used.
assumptions.head_marital_status: Assumed split, differentiated by head sex (male heads skew married; female heads skew widowed/divorced, reflecting well-established but not-cited-here headship patterns): not sourced from a specific UDHS/Census table in this pass.
assumptions.head_education_level: Assumed distribution (None/Some Primary/Completed Primary/Some Secondary/Completed Secondary/Tertiary), weighted more educated in urban/peri-urban settlement types. Not sourced from a specific table this pass.
assumptions.head_occupation: Assumed distribution weighted by settlement_type (subsistence farming dominant in rural; trading/formal employment more common in urban/peri-urban). Not sourced this pass.
assumptions.household_size_shape: Sampled from a discretised distribution around the SOURCED mean of 4.4 (NPHC 2024), shape itself (variance/skew) is assumed, not a cited household-size distribution table.
assumptions.members_ages: Child ages sampled with a skew toward younger ages, loosely motivated by Uganda's real youthful population structure (50.5% under 17, NPHC 2024 press figures) but the specific age-sampling shape is assumed, not a cited single-year age table.
assumptions.pregnancy_rate: Each eligible woman (age 15-49) assumed an independent ~9% chance of being currently pregnant — a plausible point-in-time figure, not drawn from a cited fertility/pregnancy prevalence table.
assumptions.dwelling_roof_type: Assumed distribution (iron sheet roofing dominant nationally is well-established general knowledge but no specific census table cited this pass); correlated with settlement_type/income tier.
assumptions.water_source: Assumed split of borehole/protected spring/tap/open source, correlated with settlement_type (rural: more borehole+open source; urban: more tap) — direction is realistic, exact proportions not cited this pass.
assumptions.sanitation_facility: Categories follow the real WHO/UNICEF JMP Improved/Unimproved sanitation ladder (a genuine international standard, already used elsewhere in this project), but the proportion assigned to each category here is assumed, not a cited JMP country estimate.
assumptions.cooking_fuel: Assumed split (firewood dominant rural, charcoal/LPG more common urban) — direction realistic, proportions not cited.
assumptions.electricity_access: Assumed probability by settlement_type (rural low, urban higher) — direction realistic (Uganda's rural electrification rate is known to be low), exact rate not cited this pass.
assumptions.income_distribution: Lognormal per district/settlement_type; mu/sigma parameters chosen to produce a plausible right-skewed UGX income spread (higher central tendency in Kampala/Wakiso than Gulu), not fitted to a cited income/consumption survey (e.g. UNHS).
assumptions.facility_level_and_distance: nearest_facility_level and distance_km assumed distributions by settlement_type (rural: more likely only HC II/III nearby, longer distance; urban: more Hospital/HC IV access, shorter distance) — direction realistic, exact shape assumed.
assumptions.llin_ownership: Modelled as approximately household_size/2 nets (reflecting Uganda's real 'one net per two people' universal-coverage policy target, a genuine real policy benchmark) with random variation — not a cited household LLIN ownership survey rate.
assumptions.malaria_episode: Base rate assumed, increased for rural/poor-water/poor-sanitation households and lower LLIN ownership — direction consistent with the well-established real WASH-malaria relationship, exact rate not cited this pass.
assumptions.anc_visits: For households with any woman aged 15-49, a retrospective 'last pregnancy' ANC visit count (0-8) is assumed, decreasing with distance_km and lower head_education_level per the required correlation rule — base distribution not from a cited ANC4+ coverage table (though the real UDHS 2022 ANC4+ national estimate exists, it was not verified/cited in this pass).
assumptions.immunisation_up_to_date: Base rate 63% (SOURCED: UDHS 2022 basic vaccination coverage, 12-23 months), adjusted downward for higher distance_km and lower head_education_level per the required correlation rule — the adjustment magnitudes themselves are assumed.
assumptions.chronic_conditions: Hypertension/diabetes probability increases with head_age (realistic direction, not a cited NCD prevalence table); HIV-on-ART assigned at a low flat background rate as a placeholder, not the real cited UPHIA/UDHS HIV prevalence estimate.
assumptions.reported_diarrhoea_last_2w: Household-level flag = true if any under-5 member had diarrhoea in the last 2 weeks (the real DHS standard recall convention), with probability increased by poor water/sanitation classification — exact base rate assumed, not the cited UDHS under-5 diarrhoea prevalence figure.
assumptions.parish_and_village_names: Real for Kira Division/Wakiso and Awach/Gulu only (see SOURCES). Every other parish name and all village names in this dataset are synthetic-but-plausible constructions, not real gazetted place names — no nationwide parish/village dataset exists (consistent with this project's own DATA_SOURCES.md finding).
assumptions.phone_numbers_and_nins: Not generated — the requested schema does not include a phone or NIN field, so none were fabricated, avoiding the need for a reserved/invalid number range.
